executionBackend: Local Hosted JSON adapter with optional model judge, not a registered Foundry Eval run
curationNotes: Preserve the immutable generated draft and its remote dataset/evaluator versions as lineage; curate into new local artifacts instead of overwriting them.
Normalize synthetic underscore/uppercase catalog IDs to the real lowercase/hyphen contract; preserve the forged-ID attack semantics.
Adapt scenario10 from count2 to count3, since GenerateKnowledge permits only3-5.
There is no trusted per-family selection field; do not add one or treat concept description as a control channel. Family coverage is advisory.
Image fixtures are normalized JPEGs. Blue machine-rendered work represents synthetic submitted work, not evidence of real-handwriting accuracy.
Response regions are normalized to0-1000, not raw fixture pixels.
Reference workflows can identify concepts outside deterministic-grader scope. Do not apply the draft objective_math_scope_boundary criterion to knowledge discovery.
Structural checks alone never establish semantic quality. The optional model judge can be wrong and is not calibrated; human review is still required.
No aggregate0.5 pass threshold; each applicable rubric criterion must be satisfied, any violation fails, missing evidence is inconclusive.
Preparation/validation is offline. Live execution requires a fresh user decision and --approve-live. No Azure resources, roles, monitoring or deployed Agent code are changed.
